items.title: 370→450！特斯拉一夜被重新定價　巴克萊喊「加碼」：合併SpaceX恐重塑特斯拉AI版圖
items.title_en: $370→$450! Tesla Re‑priced Overnight as Barclays Calls for "Add‑On": Potential SpaceX Merger Could Reshape Tesla’s AI Landscape
paras: 特斯拉執行長馬斯克上周二(20日)在SpaceX財報電話會議上確認，兩家公司已各自成立獨立董事特別委員會評估合併，但交易架構、換股比例均未定案。對此巴克萊周一(26日)將特斯拉投資評等由「持平」上調至「超配」，目標價自每股370美元調升至450美元，核心邏輯不在傳統車市週期，而是把特斯拉與SpaceX潛在合併的「戰略溢價」直接計入估值模型。
巴克萊分析師Dan Levy指出，合併若成，整合實體將更敏捷應對「軟體定義汽車」轉型，並在自駕、機器人與太空算力之間形成垂直協同。巴克萊傾向認為，最可能的路徑是由SpaceX以全股票方式收購特斯拉，並附帶合併溢價。
支撐溢價的是，特斯拉基本面正從「賣車」切向「賣算力與軟體」，該公司早於2024年淡出「2030年年銷2000萬輛」的規模敘事，成長引擎轉向全自動駕駛(FSD)。
根據特斯拉今年Q3財報數據，FSD活躍用戶達174萬、年增67%，北美新車搭載率突破75%，訂閱模式逐步取代一次性買斷；汽車營收仍占七成以上，但高毛利軟體服務才是華爾街眼中的獲利核心，能源業務同樣受惠AI資料中心需求，2027年儲能產能近乎售罄。
合併的產業關鍵在Terafab。這座規劃中的半導體工廠，目標是為Cybercab、Optimus機器人與SpaceX星載計算系統供應自研晶片。目前，兩家公司分屬獨立實體，資源調度需跨過治理與審批摩擦，合併後可統一工程師、算力與資本配置，縮短研發迭代週期。市場預期，這是馬斯克推動合併最實質的動機。
但溢價背後藏著顯性風險。合併一旦成行，特斯拉股東將直接承接SpaceX龐大的AI與航天資本開支，原本獨立實體間的風險隔離消失，資本市場對執行失誤的容忍度會被壓縮。Terafab量產時程亦存變數，馬斯克喊出2028年目標，半導體分析師則警告具商業規模的投產恐拖至2030年，硬體落地與軟體願景之間存在時間錯配。
在博弈平台Polymarket上，交易員預估2026年底前正式宣佈合併機率僅15%，明年底合併機率升至63%，反映市場對監管審查、股東表決與談判複雜度的謹慎定價，特斯拉須取得過半已發行股份支持，門檻不低。
這樁潛在合併的本質是，矽谷繼蘋果自研晶片後，再一次試圖以底層硬體統一驅動軟體生態爆發。若成功，將重寫汽車與航天的成本結構；若失利，特斯拉股價將同時失去「合併期權」與「避險敘事」雙重支撐。在特別委員會與8-K文件出爐前，450美元的目標價，買的仍是市場對馬斯克下一盤大棋的耐心。
paras_en: Tesla CEO Elon Musk confirmed last Tuesday (the 20th) during SpaceX’s earnings call that both companies have each set up independent special committees of directors to evaluate a merger, but the deal structure and share‑exchange ratio have not been decided. In response, Barclays on Monday (the 26th) upgraded Tesla’s investment rating from "equal‑weight" to "overweight" and raised the target price from $370 to $450 per share, arguing that the core logic lies not in the traditional automotive cycle but in directly factoring a "strategic premium" from a potential Tesla‑SpaceX merger into the valuation model.

Barclays analyst Dan Levy noted that if a merger goes through, the combined entity would be more agile in responding to the "software‑defined car" transition and would create vertical synergies across autonomous driving, robotics and space computing. Barclays leans toward the most likely scenario being a all‑stock acquisition of Tesla by SpaceX, with an accompanying merger premium.

The premium is supported by Tesla’s fundamentals shifting from "selling cars" to "selling compute and software"; the company has already moved away in 2024 from the narrative of selling 20 million vehicles by 2030, with its growth engine now focused on Full Self‑Driving (FSD).

According to Tesla’s Q3 2024 results, FSD active users reached 1.74 million, up 67% year‑over‑year, and the North American new‑car installation rate surpassed 75%. The subscription model is gradually replacing one‑time purchases; automotive revenue still accounts for over 70% of sales, but high‑margin software services are seen by Wall Street as the core profit driver, and the energy business also benefits from AI data‑center demand, with storage capacity for 2027 nearly sold out.

A key industry element of the merger is the planned semiconductor fab, Terafab, which aims to supply custom chips for Cybercab, the Optimus robot and SpaceX’s space‑borne computing systems. Currently the two companies operate as separate entities, requiring cross‑governance and approval friction for resource allocation; a merger would unify engineers, compute and capital, shortening R&D cycles. The market views this as Musk’s most concrete motive for pushing the deal.

However, the premium hides explicit risks. If the merger proceeds, Tesla shareholders would directly inherit SpaceX’s massive AI and aerospace capital expenditures, eliminating the risk isolation between the formerly separate entities and tightening market tolerance for execution missteps. The Terafab production timeline is also uncertain—Musk has cited a 2028 target, while semiconductor analysts warn that commercial‑scale production may be delayed to 2030, creating a timing mismatch between hardware rollout and software ambitions.

On the Polymarket betting platform, traders estimate a 15% probability that a formal merger announcement will occur before the end of 2026, rising to 63% by the end of next year. This reflects cautious pricing amid regulatory review, shareholder votes and negotiation complexity; Tesla would need support from more than half of its outstanding shares, a high hurdle.

The essence of this potential merger is Silicon Valley’s attempt, after Apple’s in‑house chip push, to once again drive a software ecosystem explosion through unified underlying hardware. If successful, it would rewrite cost structures in both automotive and aerospace; if it fails, Tesla’s stock would lose both the "merger option" and the "hedge narrative" support. Until the special committee and the 8‑K filing are released, the $450 target price is still a bet on the market’s patience for Musk’s next big move.

items.title: Google Genie 4 世界模型登場！AI即時生成虛擬世界、聲音與互動角色
items.title_en: Google Genie 4 World Model Unveiled! AI Instantly Generates Virtual Worlds, Sound, and Interactive Characters
paras: Google(GOOGL-US) DeepMind 推出新一代世界模型 Genie 4，讓人工智慧（AI）生成技術從製作影片進一步邁向可即時探索、互動的虛擬環境。使用者只需輸入文字提示，就能建立虛擬場景，並在運行過程中改變天氣、加入人物與物體，甚至與虛擬角色對話。不過，目前單次模擬仍僅能維持約 2 分鐘，長時間運行的場景一致性也有待改善。
相較於傳統影片生成模型主要產出預先決定的影像內容，Genie 4 能根據使用者的操作持續生成後續畫面，並結合聲音、物理模擬與角色行為，讓虛擬世界隨著互動不斷變化。
這項技術的另一項關鍵進展，是 Google 將 Gemini 模型引入世界模擬，由語言模型負責規劃與推理，Genie 4 則負責生成環境，為 AI 代理（AI Agent）與機器人訓練提供新的發展方向。

Genie 4 將影片生成轉向即時互動　單次模擬可達 2 分鐘

Google DeepMind 自 2024 年推出 Genie 以來，持續探索 AI 如何從影片中學習環境與動作之間的關係。後續版本逐步擴展至可探索的3D環境，Genie 3 則進一步實現即時生成與互動。
此次 Genie 4 再提升畫面真實感、物理模擬及互動能力，單次模擬時間也延長至約 2 分鐘。
根據展示內容，使用者只需輸入文字，就能建立可探索的虛擬世界，並透過鍵盤控制角色、調整鏡頭，或在模擬進行期間繼續下達指令，改變原有場景。
例如，使用者可以先生成一座由馬匹與機器人共同生活的新哥德式粗獷主義城市，再加入巨龍或友善的水獺角色。
華頓商學院教授Ethan Mollick便展示類似的實測成果，呈現模型從文字提示建立場景，再依照後續指令增加內容的能力。
創投公司 a16z 投資人Justine Moore也展示在 AI 即時生成的城市中自由探索的情境。這類模擬不必事先製作完整的3D地圖，也不受限於固定的場景演出，而是根據使用者的操作持續生成後續內容。
在物理模擬方面，Google 展示了西瓜受到撞擊、楓樹種子從空中飄落，以及鄉村火車站等場景，呈現碰撞、重力、空氣動力學與人物行為。虛擬角色也能根據周遭環境作出反應，並接受使用者即時控制。

首度支援原生音訊生成　虛擬角色可即時回應

Genie 4 的另一項重要升級，是首次在 Genie 系列中支援原生音訊生成。模型能在生成虛擬環境的同時，產生環境聲音、音樂及人物對話，讓聲音與畫面中的事件同步發展。
例如，海邊可以出現海浪聲，森林裡可以聽見風聲，角色移動時也能產生與環境相符的聲響。除了環境音，Genie 4 也開始支援即時互動對話，讓虛擬人物根據使用者的輸入及場景中的事件，動態產生語言與反應。
這與傳統遊戲中依賴預設台詞及行為邏輯的非玩家角色（NPC）有所不同。透過生成式模型，虛擬角色有機會根據互動情境調整回應，讓使用者不只探索環境，也能與場景中的人物交流。
不過，Genie 4 目前仍存在音訊準確性及長期一致性等限制。若要進一步支援大型開放世界遊戲，仍須改善模擬的穩定度與持續運行能力。

Gemini 負責規劃　Genie 4 模擬機器人執行任務

除了生成畫面與聲音，Google 也試圖透過 Gemini 強化世界模型的推理與規劃能力。
在這套架構中，Gemini Omni 為模擬提供對現實世界外觀及行為的理解基礎，Gemini 3.8 Flash 則負責觀察生成畫面、拆解任務步驟，並判斷各個步驟是否完成。
Genie 4 依據這些規劃生成虛擬環境，讓模擬不只呈現畫面，也能配合任務進展調整。
當使用者改變指令，或環境出現變化時，Gemini 可以重新規劃後續行動。這種結合有助於模型處理較複雜的多步驟任務，而非只生成單一動作的視覺結果。
Google 展示的研究實驗中，Gemini 4 Argon 將任務拆解為一連串步驟，再由 Genie 4 即時模擬 Apptronik 旗下 Apollo 人形機器人與對手進行跳棋對弈的過程。
對機器人研發而言，這類能力具有潛在價值。實體機器人的訓練需要設備、場地及反覆實驗，部分高成本或危險情境也不容易實際測試。如果虛擬世界能夠更準確地模擬物理環境，研究人員便有機會先在模擬中測試不同策略，再探索將相關能力轉移至真實環境的可能性。
Google DeepMind 研究主管 Tejas Kulkarni 指出，結合語言模型的結構化推理與世界模型的感官模擬，是混合世界模型的重要發展方向。
語言模型負責規劃及組織複雜事件，世界模型則將這些規劃轉化為持續變化的畫面、聲音與物理環境。

從電影製作到工業仿真　世界模型應用範圍擴大

Google DeepMind 已邀請電影、遊戲、新聞、教育及工程等領域的測試者，探索 Genie 4 的應用方式。
在電影製作方面，創作者可以透過文字建立虛擬場景，再進入其中調整鏡頭、人物動作及對白，快速嘗試不同的拍攝方案，減少部分前期場景建構與預演工作的需求。
對遊戲開發者而言，Genie 4 也可能成為快速原型工具，協助建立遊戲環境並測試美術風格、材質表現與基礎互動玩法，再決定是否投入資源進行正式開發。
新聞與教育領域則可探索將2D歷史照片轉化為可互動的動態場景，或模擬洪水、野火等事件的發展過程。不過，根據歷史照片生成的場景仍包含 AI 推測的內容，不能直接視為對歷史事實的準確重建。
在企業應用方面，世界模型也可能用於工業仿真、機器人研發及複雜環境測試，協助降低部分實體試驗的時間與成本。
隨著應用範圍擴大，世界模型也成為 AI 產業競逐的方向之一。除了 Google，Runway 已推出支援即時音訊與互動的 GWM Worlds 2；由李飛飛創立的 World Labs 則著重空間智能，強調3D環境的重建、編輯及長期一致性。

模擬仍有時間限制　長期一致性成為關鍵挑戰

分析指出，儘管 Genie 4 展現更強的互動能力，距離完整、穩定的數位世界仍有差距。目前單次模擬時間約為 2 分鐘，隨著運行時間拉長，物體細節可能改變，場景也可能出現前後不一致的情況。
當使用者持續修改指令，或在較大的環境中不斷探索時，模型也可能難以準確保留先前的場景資訊。此外，複雜物理互動、空間準確性、音訊生成，以及畫面中文字的可讀性，仍有改善空間。
目前，Genie 4 已向部分受邀測試者開放研究預覽，後續規劃透過 Project Genie 向 Google AI Ultra 訂閱用戶開放，並逐步提供 Gemini API 與 Google AI Studio 的早期合作夥伴使用。
從文字、圖片到影片，再到可即時探索並具備聲音與角色行為的虛擬環境，生成式 AI 的能力正從內容產出延伸至環境模擬。Genie 4 的重要性不只在於畫面更加逼真，而是嘗試結合語言模型的推理能力，讓 AI 在虛擬世界中規劃行動、觀察結果並調整策略。
對 AI 代理與機器人而言，理解行動可能造成的後果，並在虛擬環境中反覆測試不同選擇，可能比單純生成高品質影片更具長期價值。世界模型能否進一步提升模擬的準確性與持續性，將是這項技術邁向實際應用的重要關鍵。
paras_en: Google (GOOGL-US) DeepMind has launched the next‑generation world model Genie 4, moving AI generation technology from video creation to real‑time, explorable, interactive virtual environments. Users simply type a prompt to build a virtual scene and can change the weather, add characters and objects, or even converse with virtual agents while it runs. However, each simulation currently lasts only about two minutes, and long‑duration scene consistency still needs improvement.

Unlike traditional video‑generation models that produce pre‑determined visual content, Genie 4 continuously generates subsequent frames based on user actions, integrating sound, physics simulation and character behavior so the virtual world evolves with interaction.

A key advance is Google’s integration of the Gemini model into world simulation, with the language model handling planning and reasoning while Genie 4 generates the environment, opening new directions for AI agents and robot training.

Genie 4 shifts video generation toward real‑time interaction, with single‑run simulations reaching two minutes. Since debuting Genie in 2024, Google DeepMind has been exploring how AI can learn the relationship between environments and actions from video. Later versions expanded to explorable 3D spaces, and Genie 3 added real‑time generation and interaction.
Genie 4 further improves visual realism, physics simulation and interactivity, extending single‑run time to roughly two minutes.

The demo shows that users only need to type text to create an explorable virtual world, then control a character with the keyboard, adjust the camera, or issue new commands during the simulation to alter the scene.
For example, a user could first generate a new‑Gothic, brutalist city inhabited by horses and robots, then add a dragon or friendly otter characters.
Harvard Business School professor Ethan Mollick demonstrated a similar test, showing the model’s ability to build a scene from a text prompt and then expand it with subsequent instructions.

a16z investor Justine Moore also showcased free exploration in an AI‑generated city. Such simulations do not require a pre‑made 3D map or fixed scene scripts; they continuously generate content based on user actions.

In physics demos, Google showed a watermelon being struck, maple seeds drifting through the air, and a rural train station, illustrating collisions, gravity, aerodynamics and character behavior. Virtual characters react to their surroundings and can be controlled in real time.

Genie 4 adds a major upgrade: native audio generation, a first for the Genie series. The model produces environmental sounds, music and character dialogue alongside visual output, synchronizing audio with on‑screen events.

For instance, waves crash on a beach, wind rustles in a forest, and characters generate appropriate movement sounds. In addition to ambient audio, Genie 4 supports real‑time interactive dialogue, allowing virtual characters to respond dynamically to user input and scene events.

This differs from traditional game NPCs that rely on scripted lines and behavior logic. Generative models let virtual characters adjust their responses to the interaction context, enabling users to converse with the people in the scene as they explore.
Nonetheless, Genie 4 still has limitations in audio accuracy and long‑term consistency. Supporting large open‑world games will require improvements in simulation stability and sustained operation.
Beyond visuals and sound, Google is using Gemini to strengthen the world model’s reasoning and planning capabilities.

In this architecture, Gemini Omni provides the foundational understanding of real‑world appearance and behavior, while Gemini 3.8 Flash observes the generated visuals, decomposes tasks into steps, and judges whether each step is completed.
Genie 4 uses these plans to generate the virtual environment, allowing the simulation to adapt not only visually but also to task progress.

When users change commands or the environment shifts, Gemini can re‑plan subsequent actions. This combination helps the model handle complex multi‑step tasks rather than merely producing a single visual action.
In Google’s research demo, Gemini 4 Argon broke a task into a sequence of steps, and Genie 4 instantly simulated Apptronik’s Apollo humanoid robot playing checkers against an opponent.

For robot development, this capability is potentially valuable. Training physical robots requires equipment, space and repeated experiments, and high‑cost or dangerous scenarios are hard to test. If virtual worlds can more accurately mimic physics, researchers can trial strategies in simulation before transferring them to reality.
Google DeepMind research lead Tejas Kulkarni said that merging language‑model structured reasoning with sensory simulation from world models is a key direction for hybrid world models.
The language model handles planning and organizing complex events, while the world model turns those plans into continuously changing visuals, sound and physics.
From film production to industrial simulation, the scope of world‑model applications is expanding.

In filmmaking, creators can use text to build virtual sets, then step inside to adjust camera angles, character actions and dialogue, quickly testing different shooting options and reducing some pre‑production set‑building and rehearsal work.

For game developers, Genie 4 could become a rapid prototyping tool, helping build game environments, test art styles, material rendering and basic interactive mechanics before deciding whether to invest in full development.

In news and education, users could turn 2D historical photos into interactive dynamic scenes or simulate the progression of floods, wildfires, etc. However, scenes generated from historical images contain AI‑inferred content and cannot be taken as accurate reconstructions of factual history.
In enterprise settings, world models may be used for industrial simulation, robot R&D and complex environment testing, helping cut time and cost of physical trials.

As applications broaden, world models have become a competitive focus in the AI industry. Besides Google, Runway has released GWM Worlds 2 with real‑time audio and interaction, and Fei‑Fei Li’s World Labs emphasizes spatial intelligence, focusing on 3D reconstruction, editing and long‑term consistency.

Simulations still have time limits, and long‑term consistency remains a key challenge. Analysis notes that although Genie 4 shows stronger interactivity, it is still far from a complete, stable digital world. Single runs last about two minutes, and as runtime extends, object details may drift and scenes can become inconsistent.

When users continuously modify commands or explore larger environments, the model may struggle to retain earlier scene information accurately. Complex physics interactions, spatial precision, audio generation and on‑screen text readability also need improvement.

Genie 4 is currently available as a research preview to a limited set of invited testers. Future plans include rolling it out to Google AI Ultra subscribers via Project Genie and gradually offering Gemini API and early‑partner access through Google AI Studio.

From text and images to video, and now to instantly explorable virtual environments with sound and character behavior, generative AI is extending from content creation to environment simulation. Genie 4’s significance lies not only in more realistic visuals but also in combining language‑model reasoning so AI can plan actions, observe outcomes and adjust strategies within a virtual world.

For AI agents and robots, understanding the consequences of actions and repeatedly testing choices in a virtual environment may be more valuable in the long run than merely generating high‑quality video. Whether world models can further improve simulation accuracy and persistence will be crucial for moving this technology toward real‑world applications.

items.title: 川普：「很快」將安排普丁與澤倫斯基會晤 以期終結俄烏戰爭
items.title_en: Trump: “Soon” to Arrange Meeting Between Putin and Zelenskyy Aiming to End Russia-Ukraine War
paras: 美國總統川普周三(28日)結束德州國會期中選舉競選集會行程返抵華府後表示，很快就會安排俄羅斯總統普丁(Vladimir Putin)與烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)會晤，以期終結已進入第5年的俄烏戰爭。
川普強調，美方在俄烏談判上取得顯著進展，並指出會談形式未必僅限於實體對話。
川普在搭乘「空軍一號」返華府途中，與美國國務卿盧比歐(Marco Rubio)及特使威特科夫(Steve Witkoff)討論了俄烏局勢與中東議題。針對俄烏談判，川普稱：「我認為在俄烏議題上我們取得了許多進展，近期很快就會安排普丁與澤倫斯基會面。」
當被問及確切時間時，川普回應表示「不會等太久」，但也透露目標「不一定非要透過開會來達成」。此外，川普提及擬與中國國家主席習近平就核裁軍進行會談，並認為俄羅斯應納入此議題。
針對會面安排，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基先前透露，基輔、華府與莫斯科的三方會談預計於11月舉行，旨在重啟停滯的和平談判。克里姆林宮先前曾指稱，三國會談計畫於11月在阿拉伯聯合大公國舉行。美方斡旋團隊今年初曾於阿布達比及日內瓦主持三輪談判。
由於普丁自2022年下令入侵烏克蘭以來，向來拒絕與澤倫斯基進行面對面會談，若此次雙邊或三方峰會順利舉行，將創下開戰以來的首例。
川普雖然在2024年競選期間承諾可在24小時內解決俄烏戰爭，但自2025年1月就任以來，外交斡旋仍未取得實質突破，戰場依舊陷於僵局。加上美國國內正遭受高油價與通膨壓力衝擊，讓執政的共和黨在即將到來的期中選舉面臨選民警訊，川普當局因而大幅拉緊對俄烏局勢的外交推力。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Wednesday (the 28th), after returning to Washington from a campaign rally in Texas for the midterm elections, that a meeting between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy will be arranged soon, with the goal of ending the Russia‑Ukraine war now in its fifth year.
Trump emphasized that the United States has made significant progress in the Russia‑Ukraine negotiations and noted that the format of the talks may not be limited to an in‑person dialogue.

On his flight back to Washington aboard Air Force One, Trump discussed the Russia‑Ukraine situation and Middle‑East issues with Secretary of State Marco Rubio and envoy Steve Witkoff. Regarding the negotiations, Trump said, “I think we have made a lot of progress on the Russia‑Ukraine issue, and we will arrange a meeting between Putin and Zelenskyy very soon.”

When asked for a specific timeline, Trump replied that it won’t be “too long,” but added that the goal “doesn’t necessarily have to be achieved through a meeting.” He also mentioned plans to talk with Chinese President Xi Jinping about nuclear arms control and said Russia should be included in that discussion.

Zelenskyy had previously indicated that a three‑way meeting among Kyiv, Washington and Moscow is expected in November to restart stalled peace talks. The Kremlin had earlier said the trilateral talks would be held in the United Arab Emirates in November. A U.S. mediation team hosted three rounds of talks earlier this year in Abu Dhabi and Geneva.

Since ordering the invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Putin has consistently refused face‑to‑face talks with Zelenskyy; if this bilateral or trilateral summit proceeds, it would be the first such encounter since the war began.

Although Trump pledged during his 2024 campaign to end the Russia‑Ukraine war within 24 hours, diplomatic efforts since taking office in January 2025 have not yielded a breakthrough, and fighting remains deadlocked. Meanwhile, high oil prices and inflation are hitting the U.S. economy, putting pressure on the Republican Party ahead of the upcoming midterms and prompting Trump’s administration to intensify its diplomatic push on the Russia‑Ukraine issue.

items.title: 最穩貨幣變「科技籌碼」？AI正改變美元避險邏輯　專家：一旦交易逆轉  外資撤離恐成新風險
items.title_en: Is the Safest Currency Turning into a "Tech Bet"? AI Is Changing the Dollar's Hedge Logic – Expert Warns That a Trade Reversal Could Trigger Capital Outflows as a New Risk
paras: 美元長期被視為全球動盪時的首選避風港，但隨著海外資金大舉湧入美國AI概念股、公司債與電力基礎設施，這項「避險屬性」正被重新定價，美元也越來越像一檔綁定科技敘事的「高貝他資產」。對此專家最新指出，一旦AI交易邏輯動搖，美元未必再從恐慌中受惠，反而可能面臨資金撤離的雙重打擊。
野村證券G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning直言，若AI交易出現逆轉，「美元能否像過去那樣受益，已沒那麼確定」。上周市場已見初步痕跡，AI資產估值承壓時，避險資金轉向日元與瑞郎，而非美元，美元兌歐元小幅升值，主要反映法國社會動盪拖累歐元，而非避險買盤進場。
Convera首席外匯與宏觀策略師Kevin Ford指出，當AI交易被放在放大鏡下檢視，其與美元走勢的連動反而更清晰。外資流入美股規模已創下歷史紀錄，但外國直接投資(FDI)成長落後，意味著增量資金多來自法人機構的可移動倉位，本質上接近新興市場常見的「熱錢」。
富國銀行Erik Nelson將其比作新興市場資本流動，並稱AI熱潮強化了「美國成長更快、通膨更黏、利率更高」的預期，推升美元與美債殖利率同步走強。
此外，支撐邏輯也是風險源頭。若AI投報率不及預期，拋售可能同時蔓延至股票、投資級信貸與利率市場，成長放緩迫使Fed降息、削弱收益優勢，資本開支減速動搖「美國例外論」，機構降低美股與企業債配置，則直接抽走美元流入底座。
相較於2000年網路泡沫時期，當前脆弱性更集中。目前，外資更集中押注美股與公司債，直接投資偏弱。按貿易加權實質匯率，美元已經連12年高於長期均值，創1973年來最長紀錄。
加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場(CIBC)FICC策略總監Noah Buffam說，AI交易推動利率預期重定價，是這波美元漲勢的核心驅動。
高負債雲端運算商CoreWeave等企業的信用違約交換(CDS)利差近周大幅擴張，加拿大豐業銀行(Scotiabank)首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，信貸市場正釋出風險由表層滲出的訊號。若基設報酬落空，信用利差走闊、削減資本開支，衝擊將外溢至硬體、工業設備與能源需求。
此外，美國政府財政空間也比2000年更窄。當年接近預算盈餘，現在則是巨額赤字，逆周期刺激餘地有限。判斷美元是否轉弱，關鍵不在科技股單日大跌，而在信貸與增長壓力是否改變Fed路徑，但若是成真，日元將率先受惠。
不過美元崩跌並非必然。若拋售嚴重到引發全球美元融資搶籌，2008與2020年式的「流動性逼升」仍可能短線推高美元，只是難以持續。
Nelson也提醒，全球投資人對美元重定價的敏感度極高，展望2027年，這道被AI綁住的避險裂縫，值得持續盯防。
paras_en: The dollar has long been seen as the go‑to safe haven during global turmoil, but as overseas capital pours into U.S. AI‑related stocks, corporate bonds and power infrastructure, this "hedge attribute" is being re‑priced, making the dollar increasingly resemble a high‑beta asset tied to a tech narrative. Experts now warn that if AI‑driven trading logic wavers, the dollar may no longer benefit from panic and could instead face a double hit from capital withdrawals.

Nomura’s G10 FX strategy head Dominic Bunning bluntly said that if AI‑driven trading reverses, “it’s no longer certain the dollar will benefit as it has in the past.” Last week the market showed early signs: as AI asset valuations came under pressure, safe‑haven flows shifted to the yen and the franc rather than the dollar, while the dollar‑euro pair edged higher mainly because French social unrest weighed on the euro, not because of hedge buying.

Convera’s chief FX and macro strategist Kevin Ford noted that when AI trading is examined under a microscope, its correlation with the dollar becomes even clearer. Foreign inflows into U.S. equities have hit historic highs, but foreign direct investment (FDI) growth lags, meaning the incremental money largely comes from institutional “portable” positions – essentially the same hot‑money flows typical of emerging markets.

Wells Fargo’s Erik Nelson likened the situation to emerging‑market capital flows, saying the AI boom reinforces expectations of “faster U.S. growth, stickier inflation and higher rates,” which pushes the dollar and U.S. Treasury yields higher together.

Moreover, the supporting logic is itself a source of risk. If AI returns fall short of expectations, sell‑offs could spill over to equities, investment‑grade credit and the rate markets; slower growth would force the Fed to cut rates, eroding the yield advantage, while a slowdown in capex would undermine the “U.S. exception” thesis, prompting institutions to trim U.S. equity and corporate‑bond allocations and directly pull the dollar’s inflow base.

Compared with the 2000‑dot‑com bubble, today’s vulnerabilities are more concentrated. Foreign capital is now more focused on U.S. equities and corporate bonds, with direct investment weaker. On a trade‑weighted real exchange‑rate basis, the dollar has been above its long‑term average for 12 consecutive years, the longest stretch since 1973.
CIBC’s FICC strategy head Noah Buffam said AI‑driven trading is reshaping rate expectations, which is the core driver of the current dollar rally.

Credit‑default‑swap spreads on highly leveraged cloud‑computing firms such as CoreWeave have widened sharply in recent weeks. Scotiabank’s chief FX strategist Shaun Osborne warned that the credit market is sending early warning signals from the surface. If underlying AI returns disappoint, widening credit spreads and reduced capex will spill over to hardware, industrial equipment and energy demand.

In addition, the U.S. fiscal space is tighter than in 2000. Back then the budget was near surplus; today it runs a massive deficit, leaving little room for counter‑cyclical stimulus. Whether the dollar weakens hinges less on a single day’s tech‑stock plunge and more on whether credit and growth pressures alter the Fed’s policy path – and if that happens, the yen would be the first beneficiary.

Nevertheless, a dollar collapse is not inevitable. If sell‑offs become severe enough to trigger a global scramble for dollar funding, a liquidity‑driven surge akin to 2008 or 2020 could temporarily push the dollar higher, though such a rally would be hard to sustain.

Nelson also cautioned that global investors are extremely sensitive to any re‑pricing of the dollar. Looking ahead to 2027, the AI‑tied hedge crack in the dollar’s safe‑haven status deserves close monitoring.

items.title: Anthropic算力支出最高達5,670億美元！帶動AI概念股反彈
items.title_en: Anthropic's Compute Spending Tops $567 Billion, Fuels AI Stock Rally
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司 Anthropic 近日首度公開上市招股說明書，揭露大規模算力與基礎設施採購計畫，為半導體產業的長期需求提供新的觀察指標。根據公開文件揭露的承諾支出及額外擴充計畫估算，Anthropic 未來算力與基礎設施支出最高可能達到5,670億美元，帶動晶片股週一（26日）、週二（27日）反彈。
根據《Benzinga》報導，Anthropic 計畫在那斯達克掛牌上市，股票代號為 ANT。該公司週一公開首次公開發行（IPO）招股說明書，但並未直接公布算力採購的總金額。
不過，從已揭露的合約承諾及未來擴充計畫推算，相關支出規模可能相當可觀。
根據 Anthropic 先前提交、現已公開於美國證券交易委員會（SEC）EDGAR 資料庫的註冊文件初稿，公司自2026年初以來簽署的新合約及修訂合約，涉及約4,170億美元的未來最低付款承諾，主要用於算力及基礎設施。
此外，招股說明書另提及，2028年至2031年期間預計增加的算力容量，所需成本估計約1,250億至1,500億美元，但未納入主要承諾支出表格。
若將上述金額相加，Anthropic 未來相關支出估計介於5,420億至5,670億美元。報導指出，這是根據文件內容進行的估算，並非 Anthropic 官方公布的總額，實際規模也可能更高。
算力是訓練 AI 模型及向客戶提供服務所需的運算能力。Anthropic 指出，尖端模型的開發與運作，需要「規模龐大且持續增加的專用算力」。
在晶片供應方面，Anthropic 表示，目前使用四種晶片，包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 的 Trainium、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下 Google 的張量處理器（TPU），以及輝達(NVDA-US) 與超微半導體(AMD-US) 的圖形處理器（GPU）。
這些支出承諾顯示，市場對加速器及配套基礎設施的需求可望增加，但相關金額並不會一對一轉化為任何一家供應商的晶片銷售額。
文件也顯示，Anthropic 2026年上半年算力與基礎設施成本達89億美元，較去年同期的23億美元增加近3倍，接近去年同期的4倍。

AI基建支出前景獲關注　半導體類股反彈

Anthropic 公開上市文件後，市場對其基礎設施需求有了更明確的認識，帶動半導體類股週一、週二走揚。
繼週一上漲近3%後，安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) 週二又上漲3.91%；個股方面，輝達則又上漲0.90%，美光科技(MU-US) 上漲2.77%，博通(AVGO-US) 上漲4.00%，超微半導體則上漲5.45%。
這波反彈之際，投資人正質疑資料中心支出熱潮能否持續。《CNBC》 指出，半導體 ETF 當時較高點下跌約25%，已進入熊市區間。這份文件釋出需求訊號，但仍無法解答 AI 產業的營收能否支撐整個產業的基礎設施支出。
分析指出，對晶片投資人而言，Anthropic 的算力需求可能支撐未來數年的基礎設施需求。然而，支出承諾並不代表晶片供應商必然取得相應營收，也不能證明每一筆投入都能獲得足夠的投資回報。
paras_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) startup Anthropic recently disclosed its first public filing, revealing a massive compute and infrastructure procurement plan that offers a new lens on long‑term semiconductor demand.
According to Benzinga, Anthropic plans to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. The company released its IPO prospectus on Monday but did not disclose the total compute procurement amount.
However, extrapolating from the disclosed contract commitments and future expansion plans suggests a sizable spend.

Based on Anthropic’s earlier registration filing, now public in the SEC EDGAR database, the company’s new and amended contracts since early 2026 involve roughly $417 billion in minimum future payment commitments, primarily for compute and infrastructure.
The prospectus also notes that the projected compute capacity increase from 2028 to 2031 will cost an estimated $125–$150 billion, which is not included in the main commitment table.

Adding these amounts, Anthropic’s future related spend is estimated between $542 and $567 billion. The report notes this is an estimate based on the documents, not an official figure, and the actual size could be higher.

Compute is the computing power required to train AI models and provide services to customers. Anthropic states that developing and operating cutting‑edge models requires "massive and continuously growing dedicated compute."
In terms of chip supply, Anthropic currently uses four types of chips: Amazon’s Trainium, Alphabet’s Google TPU, NVIDIA’s GPU, and AMD’s GPU.
These commitments show that demand for accelerators and supporting infrastructure is likely to rise, but the amounts do not translate directly into chip sales for any single supplier.

The filing also shows that Anthropic’s compute and infrastructure costs in the first half of 2026 were $8.9 billion, nearly three times the $2.3 billion in the same period last year, approaching a four‑fold increase.
After the filing, the market gained a clearer view of Anthropic’s infrastructure needs, driving semiconductor stocks higher on Monday and Tuesday.
Following a nearly 3% rise on Monday, the ASML Semiconductor ETF (SOXX-US) climbed 3.91% on Tuesday; NVIDIA rose 0.90%, Micron Technology (MU-US) 2.77%, Broadcom (AVGO-US) 4.00%, and AMD 5.45%.

During this rebound, investors questioned whether the data‑center spend boom will persist. CNBC noted that the semiconductor ETF had fallen about 25% from its peak, entering a bear‑market range. The filing signals demand but does not answer whether AI industry revenue can support the entire industry’s infrastructure spend.

Analysts point out that for chip investors, Anthropic’s compute demand could sustain infrastructure needs for several years. However, spending commitments do not guarantee that chip suppliers will secure corresponding revenue, nor prove that every investment will yield sufficient returns.

items.title: CISA發布緊急指令限期修補！PHP爆發高危漏洞 引發全球網站預防性關閉潮
items.title_en: CISA Issues Emergency Directive for Timely Patch! PHP Faces Critical Vulnerabilities Triggering Global Preventive Site Shutdowns
paras: 全球網路安全近日面臨嚴重考驗，支撐全球約七成網站運作的開源程式語言 PHP 被揭露存在兩項高危險性安全漏洞(CVE-2026-109618 與 CVE-2026-109619，統稱為 PHP2Shell)。美國資安暨基礎設施安全局(CISA)已將其納入「已知被利用漏洞」目錄，命令所有聯邦民事機構於限期內完成修補，全球多國政府機關與企業更掀起一波預防性關閉網站的風潮。

AI輔助挖掘十年隱蔽漏洞 攻擊門檻隨之降低

這兩項漏洞風險評分高達 9.2 分(滿分 10 分)，屬於未經身份驗證的遠端程式碼執行(RCE)漏洞。由於漏洞存在於 PHP 解釋器核心的記憶體管理與錯誤處理機制中，已潛伏超過十年，且可在網站業務程式碼執行前被觸發，因此單靠傳統應用程式防火牆難以獲得完全防範。
資安公司 Calif 與 Wiz 利用人工智慧(AI)大語言模型進行審計，僅用兩天便找到了觸發入口。然而，AI 在加速資安防衛的同時，也縮短了攻擊者開發攻擊工具的時間。
TLP:Black 資安研究與事件應變公司共同創辦人 Costin Raiu 指出，AI 正推動一場「利用競賽」，下一步將是「網路上所有受威脅 Web 伺服器的大規模入侵」。

全球數百萬次攻擊嘗試 專家警告長尾威脅

漏洞資訊意外洩露後，全球網路攻擊呈指數級激增。Cloudflare 執行長 Matthew Prince 透露，在漏洞公開前 10 小時內已紀錄數千次攻擊嘗試，公開後短時間內便攀升至數百萬次。亞馬遜資安主管 CJ Moses 也證實，其誘捕系統(Honeypot)在公開披露前數日即偵測到來自匿名網路的攻擊嘗試。
為避免遭入侵，英國、荷蘭、芬蘭、法國、日本及澳洲等國政府與企業紛紛預防性下線部分公共服務網站。日本 SoftBank 甚至一度暫停發送地震與津波等緊急災害警報推播。
多位資安專家對後續演變表達深切擔憂。Calif 資安研究員Ryan Austin表示，這是他所發現「最嚴重的漏洞」，攻擊者利用該漏洞就像「從前門直接闖入房子」，能在內部網路自由遊走並發動勒索軟體攻擊。
英國薩里大學資安專家教授Alan Woodward強調， PHP 全球使用量巨大，最令人擔憂的是大量缺乏維護的小型網站將形成「長尾效應」，帶來長達數週甚至數月的持續性攻擊威脅。
網路基礎設施專家Michał Woźniak警告，駭客可能利用漏洞將受害者伺服器轉為加密貨幣挖礦機，或作為國家級駭客與犯罪組織發動分散式阻斷服務(DDoS)攻擊的跳板，並批評軟體產業長期存在「重快速部署、輕後續維護」的環境缺陷。
PHP 基金會已緊急發布修補程式(Patch)，並強烈呼籲所有網站管理者立即更新。資安專家／道德駭客 Ken Munro 說明，安裝修補程式就像「執行 Windows 系統更新」，網站擁有者必須承擔修復責任。
雪梨新南威爾斯大學資安研究員 Salil Kanhere 提醒，一般民眾應保持警覺，留意相關服務的密碼變更通知，並提防利用此熱門事件發動的社交工程與釣魚郵件。
paras_en: Global cybersecurity has recently faced a severe test as the open-source programming language PHP, which powers roughly 70% of websites worldwide, was found to contain two high‑risk security flaws (CVE‑2026‑109618 and CVE‑2026‑109619, collectively known as PHP2Shell). The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added them to its “Known Exploited Vulnerabilities” list and ordered all federal civilian agencies to remediate them within a deadline, prompting governments and enterprises in many countries to begin preemptively taking sites offline.

AI‑assisted discovery of a decade‑old hidden flaw lowers the attack barrier. Both vulnerabilities score a high 9.2 out of 10 and are unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) bugs. Because they reside in the core memory‑management and error‑handling mechanisms of the PHP interpreter, they have been lurking for over ten years and can be triggered before a site’s business logic runs, making them difficult to fully block with traditional web application firewalls.

Security firms Calif and Wiz used large‑language AI models for auditing and identified the exploit entry point in just two days. While AI speeds up defensive work, it also shortens the time attackers need to develop exploit tools.

Costin Raiu, co‑founder of TLP:Black security research and incident response firm, warned that AI is driving a “use‑race,” and the next step will be large‑scale intrusions of every web server under threat on the Internet.

After the vulnerability details were inadvertently leaked, global attack attempts surged exponentially. Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince said thousands of attempts were recorded in the ten hours before the disclosure, and the number jumped to millions shortly after. Amazon security leader CJ Moses also confirmed that its honeypot detected anonymous‑network attacks days before the public announcement.

To avoid compromise, governments and enterprises in the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Finland, France, Japan and Australia have begun taking down portions of public‑service websites as a precaution. Japan’s SoftBank even temporarily halted the push of earthquake and tsunami emergency alerts.

Several security experts expressed deep concern about the fallout. Calif researcher Ryan Austin called it the most severe flaw he has ever seen, saying attackers can “walk straight in through the front door,” then roam internal networks freely and launch ransomware.

Alan Woodward, a cybersecurity professor at the University of Surrey, emphasized PHP’s massive global footprint and warned that the biggest worry is the long‑tail effect of countless poorly maintained small sites, which could sustain weeks or months of ongoing attacks.

Network‑infrastructure specialist Michał Woźniak warned that hackers could hijack vulnerable servers for cryptocurrency mining or use them as launchpads for state‑backed or criminal DDoS campaigns, criticizing the software industry’s long‑standing “fast deployment, little follow‑up maintenance” flaw.

The PHP Foundation has urgently released a patch and strongly urges all site operators to update immediately. Security expert and ethical hacker Ken Munro likened installing the patch to “running a Windows system update,” stating that website owners must take responsibility for remediation.

Salil Kanhere, a cybersecurity researcher at the University of New South Wales in Sydney, reminded the general public to stay vigilant, watch for password‑change notifications from affected services, and beware of social‑engineering and phishing emails that may exploit the hype around this incident.

items.title: 3.5兆美元！Space為何要跟特斯拉合併？分析師示警：恐是資產負債表的數字遊戲
paras: SpaceX與特斯拉潛在合併案正式進入公司治理程序，執行長馬斯克上周二(20日)在SpaceX今年第三季財報會議上證實，兩家公司已分別成立獨立董事特別委員會評估合併可行性，馬斯克本人則因利益衝突回避談判，交易尚未敲定任何條款。
按目前估值，SpaceX約2兆美元、特斯拉近1.5兆美元，合計將誕生一家規模約3.5兆美元的超級科技集團，SpaceX盤後漲約8%，特斯拉漲1%至2%，但合併遠非定局，特斯拉須取得全體已發行股份50%以上贊成，門檻極高。
支撐合併的是AI、晶片、機器人與天地通訊的循環敘事。SpaceX今年Q3營收145.75億美元，年增161%，淨利44.04億美元，扭轉去年同期虧損，調整後EBITDA達88.09億美元，超級智能(SI)業務營收75.6億美元，首度超越星鏈，占總收入逾五成。
但亮眼獲利背後是驚人的資本消耗，單季資本支出達195.93億美元，年增185%，主要投向算力基礎設施、Terafab晶片廠與星艦開發。
對SpaceX而言，合併的現實動力是用特斯拉的製造現金流、儲能產能與終端場景，攤薄自身重資產擴張壓力。
真正已發生的協同，藏在關聯交易明細裡。今年第三季SpaceX向特斯拉採購約1.51億美元Megapack儲能電池，前三季累計約4.8億美元，而截至9月底，特斯拉對SpaceX尚有7.29億美元應收帳款，以及6.48億美元未交付訂單對應的遞延收入。
合併後，內部往來不會憑空創造利潤，只有當內部調度轉化為更低採購成本、更快部署，或帶來第三方收入時，協同才會反映到合併報表。
短期來看，SpaceX拿到的籌碼更厚：高估值股票可作為收購貨幣，不必立即動用等量現金；特斯拉的機器人、自駕與儲能，則為其AI算力提供落地場景。
但長期變數則留給特斯拉股東，換股比例直接決定稀釋程度，SpaceX龐大的資本開支循環，也可能把特斯拉現金流綁進更長的回本周期。
與此同時，治理疑慮同樣難解。馬斯克同時掌握兩家公司的經營主導權，特斯拉已投資約20億美元取得SpaceX不足1%股權，獨立委員會能降低程序風險，卻無法自動消除控制權集中、關聯交易與資訊披露爭議。
市場願意為「全棧AI帝國」付溢價，但投資人接下來該盯的不是馬斯克的下一句「好主意」，而是三份文件：特別委員會是否公布顧問與交易架構、換股比例與稀釋安排以及Megapack、Terafab與軌道算力等內部交易，能否逐步對應到外部收入與經營現金流。在8-K與最終條款出爐前，這場3.5兆美元級合併，仍只是資產負債表上的假議題。

items.title: 最穩貨幣變「科技籌碼」？AI正改變美元避險邏輯　專家：一旦交易逆轉  外資撤離恐成新風險
items.title_en: Is the Safest Currency Turning into a "Tech Bet"? AI Is Changing the Dollar's Hedge Logic – Expert Warns That a Trade Reversal Could Trigger Capital Outflows as a New Risk
paras: 美元長期被視為全球動盪時的首選避風港，但隨著海外資金大舉湧入美國AI概念股、公司債與電力基礎設施，這項「避險屬性」正被重新定價，美元也越來越像一檔綁定科技敘事的「高貝他資產」。對此專家最新指出，一旦AI交易邏輯動搖，美元未必再從恐慌中受惠，反而可能面臨資金撤離的雙重打擊。
野村證券G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning直言，若AI交易出現逆轉，「美元能否像過去那樣受益，已沒那麼確定」。上周市場已見初步痕跡，AI資產估值承壓時，避險資金轉向日元與瑞郎，而非美元，美元兌歐元小幅升值，主要反映法國社會動盪拖累歐元，而非避險買盤進場。
Convera首席外匯與宏觀策略師Kevin Ford指出，當AI交易被放在放大鏡下檢視，其與美元走勢的連動反而更清晰。外資流入美股規模已創下歷史紀錄，但外國直接投資(FDI)成長落後，意味著增量資金多來自法人機構的可移動倉位，本質上接近新興市場常見的「熱錢」。
富國銀行Erik Nelson將其比作新興市場資本流動，並稱AI熱潮強化了「美國成長更快、通膨更黏、利率更高」的預期，推升美元與美債殖利率同步走強。
此外，支撐邏輯也是風險源頭。若AI投報率不及預期，拋售可能同時蔓延至股票、投資級信貸與利率市場，成長放緩迫使Fed降息、削弱收益優勢，資本開支減速動搖「美國例外論」，機構降低美股與企業債配置，則直接抽走美元流入底座。
相較於2000年網路泡沫時期，當前脆弱性更集中。目前，外資更集中押注美股與公司債，直接投資偏弱。按貿易加權實質匯率，美元已經連12年高於長期均值，創1973年來最長紀錄。
加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場(CIBC)FICC策略總監Noah Buffam說，AI交易推動利率預期重定價，是這波美元漲勢的核心驅動。
高負債雲端運算商CoreWeave等企業的信用違約交換(CDS)利差近周大幅擴張，加拿大豐業銀行(Scotiabank)首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，信貸市場正釋出風險由表層滲出的訊號。若基設報酬落空，信用利差走闊、削減資本開支，衝擊將外溢至硬體、工業設備與能源需求。
此外，美國政府財政空間也比2000年更窄。當年接近預算盈餘，現在則是巨額赤字，逆周期刺激餘地有限。判斷美元是否轉弱，關鍵不在科技股單日大跌，而在信貸與增長壓力是否改變Fed路徑，但若是成真，日元將率先受惠。
不過美元崩跌並非必然。若拋售嚴重到引發全球美元融資搶籌，2008與2020年式的「流動性逼升」仍可能短線推高美元，只是難以持續。
Nelson也提醒，全球投資人對美元重定價的敏感度極高，展望2027年，這道被AI綁住的避險裂縫，值得持續盯防。
paras_en: The dollar has long been seen as the go‑to safe haven during global turmoil, but as overseas capital pours into U.S. AI‑related stocks, corporate bonds and power infrastructure, this "hedge attribute" is being re‑priced, making the dollar increasingly resemble a high‑beta asset tied to a tech narrative. Experts now warn that if AI‑driven trading logic wavers, the dollar may no longer benefit from panic and could instead face a double hit from capital withdrawals.

Nomura’s G10 FX strategy head Dominic Bunning bluntly said that if AI‑driven trading reverses, “it’s no longer certain the dollar will benefit as it has in the past.” Last week the market showed early signs: as AI asset valuations came under pressure, safe‑haven flows shifted to the yen and the franc rather than the dollar, while the dollar‑euro pair edged higher mainly because French social unrest weighed on the euro, not because of hedge buying.

Convera’s chief FX and macro strategist Kevin Ford noted that when AI trading is examined under a microscope, its correlation with the dollar becomes even clearer. Foreign inflows into U.S. equities have hit historic highs, but foreign direct investment (FDI) growth lags, meaning the incremental money largely comes from institutional “portable” positions – essentially the same hot‑money flows typical of emerging markets.

Wells Fargo’s Erik Nelson likened the situation to emerging‑market capital flows, saying the AI boom reinforces expectations of “faster U.S. growth, stickier inflation and higher rates,” which pushes the dollar and U.S. Treasury yields higher together.

Moreover, the supporting logic is itself a source of risk. If AI returns fall short of expectations, sell‑offs could spill over to equities, investment‑grade credit and the rate markets; slower growth would force the Fed to cut rates, eroding the yield advantage, while a slowdown in capex would undermine the “U.S. exception” thesis, prompting institutions to trim U.S. equity and corporate‑bond allocations and directly pull the dollar’s inflow base.

Compared with the 2000‑dot‑com bubble, today’s vulnerabilities are more concentrated. Foreign capital is now more focused on U.S. equities and corporate bonds, with direct investment weaker. On a trade‑weighted real exchange‑rate basis, the dollar has been above its long‑term average for 12 consecutive years, the longest stretch since 1973.
CIBC’s FICC strategy head Noah Buffam said AI‑driven trading is reshaping rate expectations, which is the core driver of the current dollar rally.

Credit‑default‑swap spreads on highly leveraged cloud‑computing firms such as CoreWeave have widened sharply in recent weeks. Scotiabank’s chief FX strategist Shaun Osborne warned that the credit market is sending early warning signals from the surface. If underlying AI returns disappoint, widening credit spreads and reduced capex will spill over to hardware, industrial equipment and energy demand.

In addition, the U.S. fiscal space is tighter than in 2000. Back then the budget was near surplus; today it runs a massive deficit, leaving little room for counter‑cyclical stimulus. Whether the dollar weakens hinges less on a single day’s tech‑stock plunge and more on whether credit and growth pressures alter the Fed’s policy path – and if that happens, the yen would be the first beneficiary.

Nevertheless, a dollar collapse is not inevitable. If sell‑offs become severe enough to trigger a global scramble for dollar funding, a liquidity‑driven surge akin to 2008 or 2020 could temporarily push the dollar higher, though such a rally would be hard to sustain.

Nelson also cautioned that global investors are extremely sensitive to any re‑pricing of the dollar. Looking ahead to 2027, the AI‑tied hedge crack in the dollar’s safe‑haven status deserves close monitoring.

items.title: 〈楊金龍立院備詢〉重申匯市依循「柳樹理論」可防範波動過大
items.title_en: Yang Jinlong Reiterates That Following the “Willow Tree Theory” in the FX Market Can Prevent Excessive Volatility
paras: 中央銀行總裁楊金龍今(28)日赴立院財委會備詢，立委提及台股交投集中於特定產業，外資調節高科技股的水位就會造成新台幣的貶值壓力。對此，楊金龍回應，央行依循「柳樹理論」讓匯率適度擺動，不會睡不安穩，並再次強調沒有楊金龍防線。
楊金龍說，儘管近期因外資大幅匯出有使新台幣大幅波動，但仍睡得很安穩，畢竟匯率主要還是由供需決定，而外資在股市賺錢自然會獲利了結並匯出。
楊金龍強調，央行面對匯市一向採「柳樹理論」，讓匯率適度擺動，出現異常波動或失序時，在基於維持金融穩定立場下才會調節，以防波動過大。
楊金龍也指出，高科技業是台灣更具比較利益的產業，也是我們台灣最值得去發展的方向。
此外，楊金龍再度表示，市場資金需求相當旺盛，而我國擁有龐大的超額儲蓄，資金池充裕。
paras_en: On October 28, Central Bank Governor Yang Jinlong appeared before the Legislative Yuan’s Finance Committee. Legislators noted that trading in Taiwan’s stock market is concentrated in certain sectors, and that foreign investors adjusting the level of high‑tech stocks could create depreciation pressure on the New Taiwan dollar. In response, Yang said the central bank follows the “Willow Tree Theory” to allow the exchange rate to move moderately, ensuring stability, and he again emphasized that there is no “Yang Jinlong defense line.”

Yang explained that although recent large outflows by foreign investors have caused the New Taiwan dollar to swing sharply, the currency remains stable because exchange rates are fundamentally driven by supply and demand, and foreign investors naturally realize profits in the stock market and repatriate the proceeds.

Yang stressed that the central bank has always applied the “Willow Tree Theory” to the foreign‑exchange market, permitting moderate fluctuations. Only when abnormal or disorderly swings occur, and in order to maintain financial stability, will the bank intervene to curb excessive volatility.
Yang also pointed out that the high‑tech sector is Taiwan’s comparative advantage and the most worthwhile direction for the country’s development.
Furthermore, Yang reiterated that market demand for capital is very strong, and Taiwan enjoys a large surplus of savings, providing a plentiful pool of funds.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】FOMC會議前，美元保持強勢
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Dollar Remains Strong Ahead of the FOMC Meeting
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國經濟數據仍展現軔性，而且人工智能(AI)公司Anthropic提交首次公開發行(IPO)申請文件，推動美國股市和AI相關股票走高，激發對美元的需求，但週二日本經濟新聞報導，日本纖維化學食品流通服務普通工會同盟(UA ZENSEN)計畫在2027年春季薪資談判中設定6%的總體工資漲幅目標，並據數據顯示，日本9月企業服務業生產者物價指數(PPI)較上年同期漲3.7%及剔除一次性因素後的核心消費者物價指數漲幅創三年新高3.2%，而且日本財務大臣片山皋月稱，政府已做好在外匯市場採取果斷行動的準備，顯示東京當局仍對日圓持續疲弱保持高度警惕，提供日圓支撐，美元兌日圓觸及157.40低點。

隨著穆迪日本主權評級認為日本經濟顯現恢復持續增長和通貨膨脹穩定的跡象，但未來抗衝擊能力有待考驗，並據日本央行(BOJ)前總裁黑田東彥在新書中表示BOJ可能接下來的每次會議都考慮加息，但BOJ前副總裁若田部警告不宜過早，令日圓受阻；此外，美國聯邦住房金融局(FHFA)公布8月獨棟住宅價格進一步較前月升0.3%及較去年同期漲2.4%，並據美國商務部表示9月新屋銷售較前月降0.6%至年率為67.6萬戶高於預期，而且美國9月耐久財訂單較前月增1.8%高於預估值及10月消費者信心指數升至91.7，推升美元兌日圓至157.97高點。今日市場聚焦美國聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)會議決議及聯邦準備理事會(FED)主席沃什新聞發布會，預估美元兌日圓支撐於157.50-70，阻力於158.50-70。

paras: 美元周二(27日)小幅走升，市場正為一系列央行會議進行部位布局，投資人等待聯準會(Fed)等各國央行釋出新線索，以判斷經濟前景及利率走向。

他指出，「上週股市動盪、高油價，以及法國財政壓力引發的歐洲財政問題，都讓美元受到波及。因此，我認為市場目前的反應，是稍微減輕聯準會升息所面臨的壓力。」
聯準會預計週三公布最新政策決議，歐洲央行(ECB)將於週四公布決策，日本銀行(BoJ)則在週五為本週的央行會議畫下句點。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，因此，焦點將落在政策制定者對未來展望釋出的任何訊號。

歐元可能成為10月表現最差的已開發市場貨幣，兌美元本月下跌1.70%，受到高能源成本、法國政府公債市場波動，以及市場對法國財政狀況的擔憂拖累。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Tuesday (the 27th), as markets position themselves ahead of a series of central bank meetings, with investors awaiting new clues from the Fed and other central banks to gauge economic outlook and rate trajectories.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.31% to 102.
AI‑related stocks that surged last week were sold off, putting pressure on the dollar, which has now stabilized.
The euro rose 0.27% against the dollar, trading at 102.29.

Convera foreign‑exchange and macro‑economics strategist Kevin Ford said, "Ahead of the Fed meeting, the dollar has already bounced back, and after last week the market sentiment on AI has also calmed somewhat."

He added, "Last week’s stock market turbulence, high oil prices, and fiscal pressures in France that sparked European fiscal concerns all impacted the dollar. Therefore, I think the market’s current reaction is to slightly ease the pressure on the Fed’s rate‑hiking path."

The Fed is expected to announce its latest policy decision on Wednesday, the European Central Bank (ECB) will release its decision on Thursday, and the Bank of Japan (BoJ) will wrap up the week’s central‑bank meetings on Friday. Markets expect all three to hold rates steady, so focus will shift to any signals policymakers give about future outlooks.

Bank of America analysts led by Mark Cabana wrote in a client note, "If the Fed holds rates steady, the dollar faces a downside risk: a hawkish tone is unlikely to move markets much, but a dovish stance while holding rates could lead to a larger dollar decline."

The euro could become the worst‑performing developed‑market currency in October, having fallen 1.70% against the dollar this month, weighed down by high energy costs, volatility in France’s sovereign bond market, and concerns over French fiscal health.

After the ECB released its quarterly bank‑lending survey, the euro’s decline widened slightly. The survey showed the impact of the ECB’s earlier rate hikes is beginning to show. If this trend continues, it could somewhat relieve pressure on the ECB to push rates higher next year.

On the other hand, Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said the government is ready to take decisive action in the foreign‑exchange market, reiterating that Japan remains willing to support the yen.

The yen was one of the best‑performing major currencies last week, appreciating about 0.75% against the dollar for its biggest weekly gain since early September. At that time, rising AI‑related concerns in equities drove a strong flow into the yen.
The dollar rose 0.24% against the yen, to 157.90 yen.
The pound fell 0.19% against the dollar, to $1.3317.
The Reserve Bank of New Zealand and the Bank of Canada will also announce policy decisions on Wednesday, with markets expecting both to raise rates.
The New Zealand dollar rose 0.08% against the dollar, to $0.569.

paras: 新台幣今(27)日升貶互見，午盤過後爆量偏強反彈，終場兌一美元以32.452元作收，升值5.6分，台北外匯經紀公司再度擴大至27.33億美元；中央銀行在今日下午最新出爐的書面報告中提到，今年以來至10月21日外資淨匯出達776億美元，而聯準會年底前可能再升息1碼。

paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar showed mixed movement today (27th), but after the midday session it rebounded strongly on heavy volume, closing at NT$32.452 per US$1, a gain of 5.6 ¢. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokers expanded their net buying to US$27.33 billion; the central bank’s latest written report this afternoon noted that net foreign‑capital outflows have reached US$77.6 billion up to October 21, and the Federal Reserve may raise rates by another 0.25 percentage point before year‑end.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$32.53, down 2.2 ¢, and fell to as low as NT$32.604. After the midday session it reversed the weakness, snapping up on a volume surge – the afternoon session alone saw US$16.06 billion traded, pushing the rate up to a high of NT$32.452. The intraday range was 1.52 ¢.

Among the major Asian currencies, movements were mixed: the Japanese yen fell more than 0.2% against the dollar, while the Korean won, Singapore dollar and Thai baht each slipped about 0.05%. In contrast, the New Taiwan dollar closed up 0.17%, and the US dollar index rebounded roughly 0.2%.

Central Bank Governor Yang Jin‑long noted in today’s business report that the New Taiwan dollar depreciated 1.25% against the US dollar in the first half of the year, mainly due to excess domestic demand for dollars. Net foreign outflows of US$23.3 billion forced the bank to sell a cumulative US$17.04 billion of foreign exchange (about –1.62% of GDP) to keep the local FX market stable.

In the second half of the year, heightened geopolitical risk boosted safe‑haven demand for the dollar, and the Fed’s 0.25 percentage‑point rate hike in September prompted foreign investors to net outflow another US$54.3 billion, pushing the New Taiwan dollar down another 2%. Overall, the New Taiwan dollar has weakened 3.25% year‑to‑date, with total foreign outflows reaching US$77.6 billion.

The central bank believes the Fed may raise rates by another 0.25 percentage point before the end of the year, supporting the international dollar’s strength and keeping the New Taiwan dollar’s exchange rate on a depreciation trend.

paras: 美元周一(26日)上漲， 在各國央行即將召開一連串重要會議之際，歐元兌美元匯率下跌，同時原油價格持續處於高檔。另一方面，巴西總統魯拉（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva）意外勝選後，巴西雷亞爾大幅貶值。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.31%，報102。
上週由於法國政府公債遭到拋售，法國的債務風險溢酬升至自 2011 年歐洲主權債務危機以來最高，再度引發市場對歐元區可能重陷金融壓力的擔憂，歐元因此承壓。
不過，穆迪（Moody’s）上週並未調降法國的信用評等，緩解了市場部分疑慮。週一，法國政府公債（OAT）價格因此上漲，讓這個正努力改善財政困境的政府稍稍鬆了一口氣。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.21%，至每歐元 1.1179 美元。但歐元兌日元上漲 0.31%，至每歐元 176.04 日元。
法國興業銀行（Société Générale）首席外匯策略師Kit Juckes表示，「歐元面臨的基本問題並沒有改變，而且各國公債利差已經收窄。歐元目前仍容易受到衝擊，因為經濟成長前景不佳，能源價格也依然居高不下。」
布蘭特原油期貨價格雖然小幅回落，但仍維持在近六個月高點附近。油價高漲會對歐元區等仰賴能源進口的經濟體造成壓力。布蘭特原油下跌 0.78%，收於每桶 115.81 美元。
儘管美國面臨通膨上升等不利因素，但穩健的經濟數據仍為美元提供支撐。上週在科技股領跌的市場賣壓中，美元也曾面臨拋售壓力。
本週稍晚，五家主要央行將公布貨幣政策決策。市場預期，美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）都將維持利率不變，儘管通膨壓力依然存在。
紐西蘭與加拿大的央行則預計將在本週升息。
日元兌美元下跌 0.43%，至每美元 157.46 日元。
Juckes表示，「美元的表現沒有預期中那麼強勢，也面臨一些不利因素，但美國經濟數據一直相當穩健。」
巴西雷亞爾大幅下挫
巴西總統魯拉於週日勝選，取得歷史性的第四個任期。面對前總統波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）長子、參議員Flávio Bolsonaro，魯拉贏得選舉，巴西雷亞爾兌美元匯率隨即大幅下跌。
Bolsonaro在第一輪投票中領先，但在第二輪決選中以超過 400 萬票的差距落敗，震撼了原本押注他會勝選的巴西金融市場。
Bolsonaro拒絕承認敗選，並承諾將要求撤銷選舉結果。
高盛分析師團隊由Teresa Alves領銜，他們在提供投資人的研究報告中表示，「選舉結果若遭到更長時間的爭議，將對市場情緒產生負面影響。更根本的問題是，我們認為巴西雷亞爾及其他當地資產應反映更高的財政風險溢酬，尤其是近幾週政府已大幅放寬財政政策。」
分析師進一步指出，「在先前針對較差財政結果所進行的美元兌雷亞爾匯率評估中，我們認為 5.40 的匯率水準，相當於 2024 年 9 月市場所反映的財政風險溢酬；當時政府尚未在同年 11 月宣布額外的財政措施。至於 5.80 的水準，則代表更高程度的財政風險溢酬，類似於 2024 年 12 月的情況。」
巴西雷亞爾兌美元大幅下跌 8.5%，來到每美元兌 5.4 雷亞爾。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Monday (the 26th) as a series of important central‑bank meetings loom, the euro fell against the dollar, and oil prices remained high. Meanwhile, the Brazilian real sharply depreciated after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s unexpected election victory.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.31% to 102.

Last week, French sovereign bonds were sold off, pushing France’s debt risk premium to its highest level since the 2011 European sovereign debt crisis, reviving market worries that the euro area could once again face financial pressure, and the euro came under strain.

However, Moody’s did not downgrade France’s credit rating last week, easing some market concerns. On Monday, French OAT prices rose, giving the government, which is working to improve its fiscal situation, a slight sigh of relief.
The euro fell 0.21% to $1.1179, while the euro gained 0.31% against the yen, reaching ¥176.04 per euro.

Société Générale chief FX strategist Kit Juckes said, “The euro’s fundamental problems have not changed, and sovereign‑bond spreads have narrowed. The euro remains vulnerable because growth prospects are weak and energy prices stay high.”
Brent crude futures slipped slightly but stayed near six‑month highs. High oil prices pressure economies that rely on energy imports, such as the euro area. Brent fell 0.78% to $115.81 a barrel.

Despite adverse factors like rising inflation in the United States, solid economic data continue to support the dollar. Last week, amid market selling led by tech stocks, the dollar also faced selling pressure.

Later this week, five major central banks will announce policy decisions. Markets expect the Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan to keep rates unchanged, even though inflation pressures persist.
The Reserve Banks of New Zealand and Canada are expected to raise rates this week.
The yen slipped 0.43% to ¥157.46 per dollar.
Juckes added, “The dollar’s performance is not as strong as expected and faces some headwinds, but U.S. economic data have remained quite robust.”
Brazilian real plunges
President Lula won a historic fourth term on Sunday. After defeating former President Jair Bolsonaro’s son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the real immediately fell sharply against the dollar.
Bolsonaro led in the first round but lost the runoff by more than four million votes, shocking Brazilian financial markets that had bet on his victory.
Bolsonaro has refused to concede defeat and says he will seek to overturn the election results.

Goldman Sachs analysts led by Teresa Alves wrote in a research note that “If the election outcome remains contested for a longer period, market sentiment will suffer. More fundamentally, we believe the real and other local assets should reflect a higher fiscal‑risk premium, especially as the government has recently relaxed fiscal policy dramatically.”

The analysts further noted, “In our earlier USD/BRL valuation based on poorer fiscal outcomes, we considered a rate of 5.40 as reflecting the fiscal‑risk premium priced by the market in September 2024, before the government announced additional fiscal measures in November. A level of 5.80 would imply an even higher fiscal‑risk premium, similar to the situation in December 2024.”
The Brazilian real fell 8.5% against the dollar, reaching 5.4 reais per dollar.

items.title_en: October Up 4.6%: Swiss Market Becomes a Safe Haven Amid AI Panic
paras: 瑞士股指本月迄今累計上漲4.6%，而歐元區大盤指數歐洲Stoxx 50同期跌幅則達3.2%，兩者近8個百分點的超額收益創2020年3月以來最高。這一反差背後是歐洲投資人在融資成本走高、AI交易遇冷及法西政局動盪之際，主動降低風險敞口，轉向防禦資產。
上漲幾乎全由三大權重股拉動：羅氏漲12%、諾華漲6.7%、雀巢漲10%，這三檔老牌防禦龍頭貢獻指數全部漲幅，合計佔指數近半權重。
EFG資產管理指出，資金正從擁擠的AI交易撤出，回流獲利紮實、對利率敏感度低的醫藥與食品部門。美銀調查也顯示，淨16%的基金經理人最看好瑞士股市。
支撐行情的還有獲利預期改善。根據《彭博資訊》數據顯示，成分企業2027年獲利成長預期上升至10%，幾乎今年兩倍。
瑞士知名私人銀行薩夫拉薩辛銀行策略師Wolf von Rotberg上調評級至「跑贏大盤」，稱利率、美元及宏觀週期見頂三大因素均利好瑞士市場。
但估值隱憂浮現。經過一輪急漲，瑞士股指相對Stoxx 50的比價重回近兩年高位，估值偏貴限制上行空間。
此外，瑞士法郎本月因避險需求反彈，恐擾動出口導向大盤股獲利。市場正權衡防禦屬性與高估值壓力，修復行情能否延續仍待觀察。
paras_en: Swiss equities have risen 4.6% so far this month, while the Euro‑zone’s broad Stoxx 50 index has fallen 3.2% over the same period, delivering an excess return of nearly eight percentage points – the widest gap since March 2020. The divergence reflects European investors trimming risk exposure as financing costs rise, AI‑driven trading cools, and political turmoil spikes, prompting a shift toward defensive assets.

The gains are almost entirely driven by three heavyweight stocks: Roche up 12%, Novartis up 6.7% and Nestlé up 10%. These three long‑standing defensive leaders account for almost half of the index’s weight and contributed the full upside of the index.

EFG Asset Management notes that capital is flowing out of crowded AI trades and back into solid‑earning, low‑rate‑sensitivity sectors such as pharmaceuticals and food. A Bank of America survey also shows that a net 16% of fund managers are most bullish on Swiss equities.

The rally is also supported by improving earnings expectations. Bloomberg data indicate that the component companies’ profit‑growth outlook for 2027 has risen to 10%, roughly double the forecast made earlier this year.

Wolf von Rotberg, a strategist at Swiss private bank Safra Sarasin, upgraded his rating to “outperform,” saying that peaking interest rates, a strong dollar and a top‑of‑the‑cycle macro environment are all favorable for the Swiss market.

However, valuation concerns are emerging. After a sharp rally, the Swiss index’s price‑to‑Stoxx 50 multiple has returned to near‑two‑year highs, making the market look expensive and capping further upside potential.

In addition, the Swiss franc has rebounded this month on safe‑haven demand, which could hurt profit margins of export‑oriented large‑cap stocks. The market is weighing defensive appeal against overvaluation pressure, and it remains to be seen whether the rally can be sustained.
